title: Transport of additive filtered Postnikov abutments
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories, and suppose D(A) is a derived category with its standard t-structure. For any PostnikovPageData P and PostnikovAbutmentData H, H.Transport holds: every additive natural abutment isomorphism transports the canonical filtration, step functors and graded quotients with their specified inclusion, quotient, naturality and addition squares. The witness interfaces are defined in [def-per-postnikov-additive-witness-data].

source.place: Tag 0121: image filtrations and associated graded; image under an isomorphism and the induced cokernel comparison.

proof.text: Image the canonical filtration under the composite of the abutment comparison and the given natural isomorphism. Each original step is canonically isomorphic to its image since its inclusion is monic. Cancel step inclusions to prove the adjacent-step squares, and pass these to cokernels for the graded isomorphisms. Postcompose the existing natural inclusions with the natural isomorphism. Naturality proves the map squares and existing functor additivity proves the addition equations. Uses [def-sp-filtration], [def-sp-abelian].
